These describe code outside this batch, so the underlying source changes must be checked in their own units. Whether the described Gemma 4 prefill geometry change affects the memory admission or media-attention (bidirectional) behavior cannot be verified here.

No security regression, new attack surface, or invalidated threat assumption is visible in the supplied evidence.
